description: Defines a template class 'OrderedDict' implementing an ordered dictionary similar to Python's OrderedDict, including methods for insertion, lookup, iteration, and comparison.

classes.name: OrderedDict
classes.description: A template class implementing an ordered dictionary with key-value pairs, supporting insertion, deletion, iteration, and comparison.

classes.name: OrderedDict::Item
classes.description: A nested class representing a key-value pair within the OrderedDict.

methods.name: OrderedDict(std::string key_description)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the OrderedDict with a key description.

methods.name: OrderedDict(std::initializer_list<Item> initializer_list)
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a list of items.

methods.name: key_description()
methods.description: Returns the description of the keys.

methods.name: front()
methods.description: Returns the first item, throws if empty.

methods.name: back()
methods.description: Returns the last item, throws if empty.

methods.name: operator[](size_t index)
methods.description: Access item by index, throws if out of bounds.

methods.name: operator[](const Key& key)
methods.description: Access value by key, throws if key not found.

methods.name: find(const Key& key)
methods.description: Returns pointer to value if key exists, nullptr otherwise.

methods.name: insert(K&& key, V&& value)
methods.description: Inserts key-value pair, throws if key exists.

methods.name: erase(const Key& key)
methods.description: Removes item by key, throws if key not found.

methods.name: items()
methods.description: Returns const reference to items vector.
